title: fix(app-shell): Studio's API tab shows an example create body the server would accept (objectui#11803)
body:
Fixes #11803

Clause-②: no

Studio, object, Advanced, API, *Example body*: each value now fits its field's type, and every required field is listed.

## What changed

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectApiPanel.tsx`: `placeholderFor` is replaced by `exampleElementFor` / `exampleValueFor`, and `buildExampleBody` is rewritten.

- **Values from the spec's value contract.** Each value is chosen by the value classes `@objectstack/spec/data` exports (`STRING_VALUE_TYPES`, `NUMERIC_VALUE_TYPES`, `SINGLE_OPTION_TYPES`, `MULTI_OPTION_TYPES`, `REFERENCE_VALUE_TYPES`, `FILE_REFERENCE_TYPES`, the date/time classes, `isMultiValueField`), imported by reference, not re-listed.
  - select / radio: the first option's code; multiselect / checkboxes: an array of it.
  - location: `{ "lat", "lng" }`; address: an object of declared keys; time: `09:00`.
  - email / url / phone: samples that pass the write path's format checks.
  - lookup / master_detail / user / tree: a record id; media types: a file id; an array of one when the field is multi-valued.
  - json / composite / record: `{}`; repeater: `[]`.
  - A number is moved inside `min` / `max`, a string inside `minLength` / `maxLength`, and a `text` field's `valueDomain` gets a member of the domain.
- **Field selection.** Required fields come first, all of them, always. Optional fields follow, the object's own before the platform's (`system: true`, such as `owner_id`, which the platform stamps when left out), up to 8 fields in all. Computed (`COMPUTED_VALUE_TYPES`), read-only and hidden fields stay skipped.
- **A line names what is left out.** A muted line under the example lists the optional fields not shown: new row `engine.studio.api.bodyOmitted` in the metadata-admin designer's own table, en and zh. (The claim named the family `engine.studio.data.api.*`; the row sits beside its siblings under `engine.studio.api.*`.)
- The body is built with `Object.fromEntries`, so a field named `__proto__` is no longer dropped from it.

## Premise check: the Authorization half was already done

- `curlFor` already emitted the `Authorization: Bearer` header on objectui `179f6fe9` (the filer's HEAD) and on `b0aa892` (this branch's base). The file is byte-identical between the two commits.
- The panel's visible subtitle already says "Copy a request as cURL and call it with your API token." The only request block shown on screen is the body, which carries no headers.
- So that half is verified-done and not re-implemented. The new cURL case pins it, and it is green on the pre-fix tree too (below).

## Why the cap is 8, measured on showcase Account

- The served definition lists the injected columns first (`applySystemFields` spreads `{ ...additions, ...schema.fields }`). On `b0aa892` the 8 were `owner_id, name, industry, annual_revenue, website, hq, status, sales_region`, with `owner_id` ahead of the object's own fields.
- Writable fields: 12 authored plus `owner_id`. Now the body is `name, status, industry, annual_revenue, website, hq, sales_region, signed_on`, and the line names `tax_id, support_config, churn_reason, billing_email, owner_id`.
- Each of those four authored omissions carries a validation rule in `account.object.ts` (tax-id regex, email format, JSON schema, churn-reason conditional) that a generated value would trip; the 8 shown trip none. This is a reading of the rules, not a live server run.
- The write path's email / url / phone regexes, read from objectstack `51290bca`, accept the three samples and refuse `"string"`. So on `b0aa892` the Account example's `website: "string"` alone was refused (`invalid_url`).
- Required fields are exempt from the cap: the showcase field zoo's required `f_master_detail`, declared about 25th, is listed second now; on `b0aa892` it was missing.

## Tests

New: `ObjectApiPanel.exampleBody-11803.test.tsx`, 8 cases. The oracle is `valueSchemaFor(def, 'stored')` from `@objectstack/spec/data`, plus `isValueDomainMember` for value domains.

Reverse verification: the fix was committed first, the panel reverted to the `b0aa892` blob, and restored with `git checkout HEAD`; the restore was proven by blob-hash equality and an empty `git diff HEAD`. Result: **7 failed, 1 passed (8)**.

- The failures read `expected 'string' to be 'technology'`, `f_time (time) = "string"`, `expected 'related_record_id' to deeply equal [ Any(String) ]`, `expected +0 to be 5`, `... to have property "f_master_detail"`, and `expected [ 'owner_id', 'name' ] to deeply equal [ 'name', 'status' ]`.
- The 1 green is the cURL Authorization case: the half that was already done.

Gates at `311188d`, the HEAD after the last commit:

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectApiPanel.exampleBody-11803.test.tsx`: `Tests 8 passed (8)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0, zero `error TS`, both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`. `--listFilesOnly` shows the test config includes the new test file.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the 3 touched source files: exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: `3 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: OK.
- `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check-changeset-no-major`: exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED locally: `pnpm lint`, the full `pnpm test`, and the eager-closure budget, which needs a console build; CI runs them. The console imports Studio lazily (`StudioRoute`), and `@objectstack/spec/data` was already a runtime import of app-shell.

## Acceptance notes

- **Vector:** the value contract types the element as a number but does not bind the length to `dimensions`. The example shows `[0, 0, 0]` as a neutral placeholder.
- **Option field with no options yet**, such as a just-bound `picklist` in an unsaved draft: it falls back to a free-form string, which the write path would refuse. Served drafts carry the resolved options.
- **Object-level validation rules** (format, JSON schema, conditional) cannot be satisfied from a field declaration. An object whose rule targets a shown optional field can still refuse the example.
- **`secret`:** a write is refused on a stack with no crypto provider, and a secret field can be among the optional fields shown.
- **cURL quoting:** `-d` wraps the body in single quotes without escaping one inside it. No example value can contain one today: field names and option codes are identifiers, and the samples are fixed. Dormant.
- The filer counted 23 fields on Account. Reading `applySystemFields` and `provisionSearchCompanion` gives 21: 13 authored, 7 injected ahead, and `__search`. The other 2 are not identified; nothing here depends on the total.
